raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Fig. 5 design domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 delegates the domain geometry to Fig. 5. Neither the prose nor caption gives its outline, dimensions, or aspect ratio; 200×200 specifies element counts only.",
      "readings": [
        "Full unit square: [0,1]×[0,1].",
        "Full rectangle: [0,2]×[0,1].",
        "Full rectangle: [0,1]×[0,2]."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Nodes restrained against vertical displacement",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 says the center nodes on 'each side' are vertically restrained without identifying the sides. This can mean the two opposing compression sides or every boundary side.",
      "readings": [
        "Restrain vertical displacement at the left and right edge midpoints only.",
        "Restrain vertical displacement at all four edge midpoints."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Two compression load patches",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 locates the loads around the horizontal symmetry axis but does not explicitly identify their supporting faces or horizontal coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the patches to the outer left and right boundaries, centered at mid-height.",
        "Apply the patches to internal vertical faces 0.025 model units inward from the left and right boundaries, representing inner faces of end pads."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Force distribution within each 0.04-wide load patch",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies distributed loads and their width, but gives neither a spatial profile nor the rule for assembling nodal forces.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform edge traction with consistent finite-element loading, giving half weights to patch endpoint nodes on a uniform grid.",
        "Equal nodal forces at every selected node, including patch endpoints.",
        "A symmetric triangular traction profile, maximal at the horizontal symmetry axis and zero at the patch ends."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Magnitude of each compression load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 gives a magnitude of 10^-3 at each load without identifying it as a resultant or a distributed-load intensity.",
      "readings": [
        "Each patch has total resultant force 10^-3.",
        "Each patch has line-load intensity 10^-3 per unit length; a uniform patch of length 0.04 then has resultant 4×10^-5."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Passive solid regions at the loads",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 provides only a width of 0.025. It does not specify the width direction, the other dimension, or the complete pad footprint.",
      "readings": [
        "Boundary-attached rectangular pads with inward depth 0.025 and tangential span 0.04, matching the load patches.",
        "Boundary-attached rectangular pads with inward depth 0.025 and tangential span 0.05.",
        "Boundary-attached pads with tangential width 0.025 and inward depth 0.04.",
        "Full-height end strips with inward depth 0.025."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Passive-pad enforcement through filtering and projection",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 names passive solid regions, but Sec. 2.1 and Eq. (19) do not specify whether passivity overrides the physical fields or fixes the underlying design variables before filtering.",
      "readings": [
        "Overwrite the passive elements with physical density 1 in all three realizations after filtering and projection.",
        "Fix x=s=1 in the passive elements before filtering, then obtain their physical densities from Eqs. (5)–(7) without a subsequent override."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual-stiffness implementation in the single-scale SIMP baseline",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 delegates SIMP to reference [18]. Sec. 1 supplies p=3 for its SIMP comparison, but the text does not write the SIMP residual-stiffness formula; Eq. (8) describes HS.",
      "readings": [
        "E(ρ)=E_min+(E_0−E_min)ρ^3.",
        "E(ρ)=max(E_min,E_0ρ^3)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text specifies two-dimensional quadrilateral elements and elastic constants, but gives no thickness or explicit per-unit-thickness convention.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness, t=1.",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 in the same length units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Lower bound x_min",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. (1) and (19) introduce x_min, but Sec. 3.1 gives no numerical value. The value 0.27 is introduced specifically for the L-beam example in Sec. 3.2.",
      "readings": [
        "x_min=0.",
        "x_min=0.001.",
        "x_min=0.27."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial design for the pure-compliance optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 starts the continuation sequence at ω=1 but does not specify its initial x and s fields. The uniform-initialization statement in Sec. 3.2 applies to the other example.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform x=1, with uniform s chosen to meet the initial blueprint volume budget.",
        "Uniform x=0.5, with uniform s chosen to meet the initial blueprint volume budget, provided the selected x_min permits it.",
        "A symmetric nonuniform seed with the same initial blueprint volume."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initialization and update of the dilated volume allowance",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 says V_d* is continuously updated to enforce the blueprint target, but supplies neither its initialization nor its update rule. The blueprint target 0.15 itself is explicit.",
      "readings": [
        "At every iteration set V_d*=0.15 V(ρ^d)/V(ρ^b), using current physical volumes.",
        "Initialize V_d*=0.15 and update it every iteration halfway toward 0.15 V(ρ^d)/V(ρ^b).",
        "Initialize from the initial projected fields and recompute the volume-ratio allowance every ten iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA numerical controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.2.3 and Appendix B identify MMA but provide no move limits, asymptote parameters, or subproblem penalty coefficients needed to reproduce its optimization trajectory.",
      "readings": [
        "Move limit 0.2; initial asymptote distance 0.5 of each variable interval; expansion factor 1.2; contraction factor 0.7; constraint penalty coefficient 1000.",
        "Move limit 0.05; initial asymptote distance 0.25 of each variable interval; expansion factor 1.1; contraction factor 0.5; constraint penalty coefficient 10000."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization termination and final projection stage",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 specifies the β continuation but gives no convergence tolerances, total iteration limit, or required optimization duration after β reaches 256.",
      "readings": [
        "At β=256, stop after ten consecutive iterations with maximum design-variable change below 10^-3 and constraint violation below 10^-6.",
        "At β=256, stop when relative compliance change over twenty iterations is below 10^-5 and blueprint volume error is below 10^-4.",
        "Run a fixed total of 1000 iterations with the stated β schedule."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Bilinear quadrilateral element integration and stabilization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies 200×200 bilinear quadrilaterals, but Sec. 2.1 defers the element matrices to reference [18]; quadrature and stabilization are not stated in the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Standard displacement Q4 elements with full 2×2 Gauss integration.",
        "Q4 elements with one-point integration and hourglass stabilization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
